bns:Component.name: HR Mock - Leave Policies
bns:Component.bns:description: Leave policy catalogue used by the agent tools and by submission validation. Numeric columns drive the Business Rules checks in [SUB] HR Tool - Submit Leave Request. | MOCK DATA for demo - fictitious company and people | built with boomi-companion v1.0.103

ref.value: 12 working days per year; +2 days at 5 years of service, +4 days at 8 years

Available after 12 months of continuous service. Up to 5 unused days carry over into the next year and must be used by 31 March. Requests longer than 10 consecutive working days must be arranged with HR.
Doctor certificate (surat keterangan dokter) for absences longer than 2 consecutive working days
May be submitted up to 7 calendar days after the absence started. Absences longer than 5 working days, or any work-related illness or injury, are handled directly by HR.
Special Leave for Important Reasons (Cuti Alasan Penting)
Up to 5 paid working days per year, per qualifying event
Supporting document (for example marriage certificate or death notice) sent to HR within 5 working days

Qualifying events: own marriage (3 days); marriage, circumcision or baptism of a child (2 days); spouse giving birth or miscarriage (2 days); death of spouse, parent, parent-in-law or child (2 days); death of another household member (1 day).
Birth parent: up to 65 working days; non-birth parent: up to 10 working days
Letter from a doctor or midwife stating the expected delivery date
Approved first by the line manager and then confirmed by HR, which verifies eligibility and the entitlement that applies. HR can waive the notice period for early or unplanned births.
